## Source-listed information

- **Model Version:** CV3 574 cc, current Kymco UK specification page
- **Market:** United Kingdom
- **Vehicle Type:** Three-wheel maxi scooter
- **Engine:** 574 cc DOHC 4-stroke, 8-valve inline twin; liquid-cooled fuel injection
- **Power:** 37.6 kW at 7000 rpm
- **Torque:** 54.4 Nm at 5750 rpm
- **Transmission:** CVT
- **Front Tyre:** 110/70-13 × 2
- **Rear Tyre:** 160/60R-15
- **Front Brake:** 270 mm disc
- **Rear Brake:** 260 mm disc
- **Braking:** ABS
- **Display:** 6-inch TFT
- **Features:** Cruise control, heated grips, keyless start, two drive modes, KALS leaning suspension
- **Price:** £10,999 including VAT; official UK page checked 2026-11-02
- **Scope Note:** UK 574 cc version only. Earlier CV3 550.4 cc and other-market versions have different specifications.
